contract: 3.31.3 resilient Blu-ray enrichment: completed traversal and incomplete detail enrichment remain distinct; reviewers see exact success and retry counts plus a direct failed-only recovery path at desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844.

accessibility.evidence: Playwright exercised named review tabs, the labeled full-set checkbox, visible status text, disabled and enabled Include states, keyboard-native navigation buttons, and the Apply action.

responsive.evidence: The inspected desktop and 390x844 renders preserve the enrichment summary, edition evidence, identifiers, tabs, and review actions without horizontal overflow or clipped controls.

loading.evidence: The existing drawer shell retains its explicit Loading batch review state while detail is fetched.

empty.evidence: The existing empty review state explains when no conflicts match and keeps the full collected set available.

error.evidence: The regression fixture shows a bounded challenge-after-retry reason, keeps the affected item visible, disables Include, and points to Retry failed editions.

partial.evidence: The drawer reports Ready with issues and 1 of 2 enriched / 1 need retry while preserving the verified edition for review.

success.evidence: The verified edition exposes media format, edition, country, release year, Blu-ray ID, UPC/EAN, ASIN, source evidence, and an enabled Include action.

permission.reason: The view remains behind the shared authenticated library boundary; permission handling is not changed by this slice.

renderedEvidence.observation: The desktop drawer presents the exact enrichment and retry counts beside edition review context, with the verified item and Apply action available.
The mobile view retains Ready with issues, all review tabs, the two-column evidence layout, and reachable Include and Apply actions.
